items.title: A Mittag-Leffler kernel makes the limit of a short exact sequence of countable inverse systems exact
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a short exact sequence of countable inverse systems, if the kernel system is Mittag-Leffler then the sequence of limits is exact (statement lines 20986-20998). The proof does not apply a general exactness theorem: it reduces to surjectivity at the last term by left exactness, chooses preimages level by level, and then corrects them into a compatible family using the Mittag-Leffler property and countability of the index set (proof lines 21000-21028). The correction step that produces a compatible family is the substance of the argument. H2.
